rationale: The prompt asks for the workspace role of the user with email hubert@gmail.com in Test Workspace. The route WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP→USER correctly reflects following the unique email to the user (U06HUBERT23) and then to that user's single user_teams row (T01WORKSPACE, role='member'), matching resolution_mode 'single' since each user has exactly one membership row in the seed. The three negatives (Robert-admin, Morgan Freeman-admin, Artem-member) are plausible confusors that differ by email/user, correctly illustrating that role alone cannot substitute for the email-bound identity. Answer attributes (user_teams.role/user_id/team_id) are legitimate stored columns, not literals or computed values. Access plan is realistic: users.list/users.info can resolve email→user_id, and users.info exposes one workspace's role association per the runtime qualification, which is satisfied here since Hubert has only one workspace membership. No timestamps or unavailable fields are requested; this is a plain read-only lookup with adequate but not particularly rich negatives/complexity.
